reforms.description: Japan allocated ¥550 billion (0.1% of GDP) in the August 1992 economic package and ¥1,150 billion (0.2% of GDP) in the April 1993 package specifically for education and research, as part of broader fiscal stimulus measures.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Public R&D funding builds research capacity and human capital, supporting long-term productivity and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The August 1992 package was announced and implemented; the April 1993 package followed with additional education and research allocation.
reforms.importance_rationale: A modest allocation within a broader fiscal stimulus package; while supporting R&D, the amount (¥1.7 trillion total across two years) represents only 0.1–0.2% of GDP per package and is not a structural reform of the R&D system.
reforms.cross_verification_note: The description explicitly states that Japan allocated funds specifically for education and research, indicating direct public R&D funding.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The Japanese government introduced a comprehensive economic package amounting to ¥15.3 trillion, which includes financial and tax incentives to encourage foreign investment, reforms to the land tax system, and support for the purchase of foreign automobiles and auto parts through financial assistance for exhibitions and training.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: The package aims to stimulate domestic demand and improve market conditions for foreign investment, which can enhance overall economic growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The government has implemented the measures outlined in the economic package.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The comprehensive nature and significant financial commitment of the package indicate a major reform.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: Further changes in the land tax system, including a reduction in the capital gains tax as proposed in the February 1994 economic package and a further rise in the effective tax rate on land, would be important steps.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The description focuses on financial and tax incentives for foreign investment and does not mention direct public R&D funding or innovation instruments relevant to R&D.

all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: This reform aims to enhance domestic demand and innovation in the automotive sector by facilitating the integration of foreign technology and standards.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The reform has been put into action as part of the government's economic initiatives.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: While not a major overhaul, this reform significantly supports innovation in the automotive sector.
